sloka: वालिनम् तम् वधिष्यामि तव भार्य अपहारिणम् ।अमोघोः सूर्य संकाशाः मम इमे निशिताः शराः ॥४-५-२६॥
transliteration: vālinam tam vadhiṣyāmi tava bhārya apahāriṇam ।amoghoḥ sūrya saṁkāśāḥ mama ime niśitāḥ śarāḥ ॥4-5-26॥

translations.english: 'O great monkey I know friendship is the fruit of a beneficial deed. I will kill that Vali who has usurped your wife.
